hydra:member.name: artillery
hydra:member.description: Your Gunboat fires a high-explosive cannon shell that damages enemy buildings. Be careful not to hit your own troops!

hydra:member.name: barrage
hydra:member.description: A rapid fire artillery barrage deals massive damage to buildings in a wide target area. Warning: the Barrage is inaccurate and dangerous to nearby friendly troops!

hydra:member.name: critters
hydra:member.description: Launch these robotic troopers to distract and destroy enemy buildings.

hydra:member.name: cryobomb
hydra:member.description: The Cryo Bomb detonates to cause enemy buildings to freeze across a large area, slowing them down and dealing moderate damage.

hydra:member.name: crystal_critters
hydra:member.description: Releases a cluster of Crystal Critters borrowed from Dr. Kavan that heal wounded troops and disappear after a short duration.

hydra:member.name: crystal_shield
hydra:member.description: Provide troops with crystal shields

hydra:member.name: deployable_turret
hydra:member.description: Some stolen technology from Dr T's laboratories resulted in the creation of the deployable turret. Fire the small turret into the battlefield and watch it sit tight and obliterate the enemy.

hydra:member.name: explosive_drone
hydra:member.description: Fires a cluster of drones that take a short duration to activate, and then make a beeline for the nearest enemy building and explode, dealing damage.

hydra:member.name: flare
hydra:member.description: The Flare can be used to direct your troops. All troops will move towards the Flare while it burns, or attack a building marked by it!

hydra:member.name: medkit
hydra:member.description: Heal your troops on the battlefield. Troops inside the Medkit's area of effect will recover health.

hydra:member.name: remote_defib
hydra:member.description: Temporarily revives fallen troops, except Seekers and Choppas. Latest casualties are revived first. If there is not enough capacity to revive a large troop, Riflemen appear instead.

hydra:member.name: remote_hack
hydra:member.description: Launch the Remote Hack at a defensive building to hack it and turn it against other defenses for a duration. Once the hacking effect expires, the building is stunned for a time. Does not work on resource or HQ buildings.

hydra:member.name: shock_bomb
hydra:member.description: The Shock Bomb stuns anything it hits for a short time. Use it to disable key defensive buildings. If you hit your own troops, they will be stunned as well!

hydra:member.name: smoke
hydra:member.description: Protect your troops with a Smoke Screen. Troops inside the smoke can move, but cannot fire or be fired upon.

hydra:member.name: speed_serum
hydra:member.description: A projectile vial full of Super Secret Sauce which energizes the troops, boosting their movement and attack speed for a short duration. Caution: side effects not thoroughly tested.

hydra:member.name: super_warrior
hydra:member.description: A supercharged warrior who fearlessly hurls himself into the heart of the action. Apart from healing himself with every attack, the super warrior also freezes the building it attacks, reducing its attack rate.

hydra:member.name: tiny_shock
hydra:member.description: Launch the Tiny Shock at a defensive building and stun and freeze it for a long duration. Use it to disable key defensive buildings! Only targets a single structure.

hydra:member.name: boom_cannon
hydra:member.description: The Boom Cannon fires devastating shots, but takes a while to reload. Even the strongest armor is no match for the Boom!

hydra:member.name: boom_surprise_1
hydra:member.description: Powerful 2-shot cannon with good range. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

hydra:member.name: boom_surprise_2
hydra:member.description: Powerful 2-shot cannon with good range. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

hydra:member.name: boom_surprise_3
hydra:member.description: Powerful 2-shot cannon with good range. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

hydra:member.name: cannon
hydra:member.description: Cannons fire powerful, large caliber shells towards one target at a time. This makes them ideal against heavy and armored enemies, but less effective against massed infantry.

hydra:member.name: critter_launcher
hydra:member.description: The Critter Launcher lobs critters at a long distance. These critters are not only a great distraction but also deal a lot of damage!

hydra:member.name: damage_amplifier_1
hydra:member.description: Amplifies the damage output of all nearby defenses using a gauss overdrive field.

hydra:member.name: damage_amplifier_2
hydra:member.description: Amplifies the damage output of all nearby defenses using a high voltage gauss overdrive field.

hydra:member.name: damage_amplifier_3
hydra:member.description: Amplifies the damage output of all nearby defenses using a high voltage hyperbolic gauss overdrive field.

hydra:member.name: doom_cannon_1
hydra:member.description: Shoots a Doom Ray that destroys most targets outright. Very slow rate of fire.

hydra:member.name: doom_cannon_2
hydra:member.description: Shoots a Doom Ray that destroys most targets outright. Very slow rate of fire.

hydra:member.name: doom_cannon_3
hydra:member.description: Shoots a Doom Ray that destroys most targets outright. Very slow rate of fire.

hydra:member.name: engine_room
hydra:member.description: The engine rooms power the mighty Warships. Destroy all Engine Rooms to destroy the Warship.

hydra:member.name: flame_thrower
hydra:member.description: The Flamethrower is a close range weapon that deals huge amounts of damage. It's especially deadly against massed infantry. Enemies will also burn for a while after being attacked by the Flamethrower.

hydra:member.name: flotsam_cannon_1
hydra:member.description: The mine wasn't dangerous enough, so they put a cannon on it! Potent defensive cannon that when destroyed detonates with a powerful explosion, causing damage in an area.

hydra:member.name: flotsam_cannon_2
hydra:member.description: The mine wasn't dangerous enough, so they put a cannon on it! Potent defensive cannon that when destroyed detonates with a powerful explosion, causing damage in an area.

hydra:member.name: flotsam_cannon_3
hydra:member.description: The mine wasn't dangerous enough, so they put a cannon on it! Potent defensive cannon that when destroyed detonates with a powerful explosion, causing damage in an area.

hydra:member.name: grappler_1
hydra:member.description: Shoots a long range grappling hook that pulls a single enemy unit close. Slowest firing Grappler.

hydra:member.name: grappler_2
hydra:member.description: Shoots a long range grappling hook that pulls a single enemy unit close. Faster reload speed.

hydra:member.name: grappler_3
hydra:member.description: Shoots a long range grappling hook that pulls a single enemy unit close. Fastest firing Grappler.

hydra:member.name: gunboat
hydra:member.description: The Gunboat provides fire support and battlefield supplies to your troops. It can also relay movement orders with Flares. Upgrade your Headquarters to access new Gunboat abilities, and upgrade the Gunboat to increase its Energy capacity.

hydra:member.name: hot_pot_1
hydra:member.description: Powerful flamethrower with improved reach. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

hydra:member.name: hot_pot_2
hydra:member.description: Powerful flamethrower with improved reach. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

hydra:member.name: hot_pot_3
hydra:member.description: Powerful flamethrower with improved reach. Stays protected in an underground bunker until enemies are in range.

hydra:member.name: landing_craft
hydra:member.description: Each Landing Craft carries a squad of troops for beach assaults. Upgrade the Landing Craft to carry more troops to the battle!

hydra:member.name: laser_beam_1
hydra:member.description: Future warfare! Lazor beams burn through any target, causing moderate damage to all enemies in its path.

hydra:member.name: laser_beam_2
hydra:member.description: Future warfare! Lazor beams burn through any target, causing serious damage to all enemies in its path.

hydra:member.name: laser_beam_3
hydra:member.description: Future warfare! Lazor beams burn through any target, causing grievous damage to all enemies in its path.

hydra:member.name: machine_gun
hydra:member.description: The Machine Gun turret sprays bullets at the enemy, rapidly dealing damage to massed infantry at close to medium range.

hydra:member.name: microwaver_1
hydra:member.description: Burns all enemies within range with dangerous microwave radiation. Damages enemies under smoke. Can also be used to make popcorn.

hydra:member.name: microwaver_2
hydra:member.description: Burns all enemies within range with dangerous microwave radiation. Damages enemies under smoke. Can also be used to make popcorn.

hydra:member.name: microwaver_3
hydra:member.description: Burns all enemies within range with dangerous microwave radiation. Damages enemies under smoke. Can also be used to make popcorn.

hydra:member.name: mortar
hydra:member.description: The Mortar is an artillery piece that is effective at medium to long range, but can't target enemies right next to it. Mortar shells explode and deal damage to all troops in the area of effect.

hydra:member.name: rocket_launcher
hydra:member.description: The Rocket Launcher is a long distance artillery piece. It fires a salvo of rockets, followed by a significant reload time.

hydra:member.name: shield_generator_1
hydra:member.description: Generates a force field around the Headquarters that shields it from damage. If the generator is destroyed, the shield dissipates.

hydra:member.name: shield_generator_2
hydra:member.description: Generates a megawatt force field around the Headquarters that shields it from damage. If the generator is destroyed, the shield dissipates.

hydra:member.name: shield_generator_3
hydra:member.description: Generates a gigawatt force field around the Headquarters that shields it from damage. If the generator is destroyed, the shield dissipates.

hydra:member.name: shock_blaster_1
hydra:member.description: The Shock Blaster shoots shock bullets at a high rate of fire, dealing heavy damage and stunning the target.

hydra:member.name: shock_blaster_2
hydra:member.description: The Shock Blaster shoots shock bullets at a high rate of fire, dealing massive damage and stunning the target.

hydra:member.name: shock_blaster_3
hydra:member.description: The Shock Blaster shoots shock bullets at a high rate of fire, dealing shocking damage and stunning the target.

hydra:member.name: shock_launcher
hydra:member.description: The Shock Launcher fires shock bombs, similar to those in your Gunboat's arsenal. Enemy troops caught in the area of effect are briefly stunned and unable to move or attack.

hydra:member.name: simo_1
hydra:member.description: Sniper tower that sniffs out and targets low health enemies within range. Can see through smoke with the help of infra-red sensors.

hydra:member.name: simo_2
hydra:member.description: Sniper tower that sniffs out and targets low health enemies within range. Can see through smoke with the help of infra-red sensors.

hydra:member.name: simo_3
hydra:member.description: Sniper tower that sniffs out and targets low health enemies within range. Can see through smoke with the help of infra-red sensors.

hydra:member.name: sky_shield_1
hydra:member.description: Sets up a defensive shield around itself, protecting all buildings under the shield from gunboat projectiles. The shield dissipates if it's bombarded enough or if the building is destroyed.

hydra:member.name: sky_shield_2
hydra:member.description: Sets up a defensive shield around itself, protecting all buildings under the shield from gunboat projectiles. The shield dissipates if it's bombarded enough or if the building is destroyed.

hydra:member.name: sky_shield_3
hydra:member.description: Sets up a defensive shield around itself, protecting all buildings under the shield from gunboat projectiles. The shield dissipates if it's bombarded enough or if the building is destroyed.

hydra:member.name: sniper_tower
hydra:member.description: The Sniper in the tower shoots at enemy attackers. He's armed with a long-range rifle that deals good damage.

hydra:member.name: bombardier
hydra:member.description: The Bombardiers can shoot with pin point accuracy from a large distance, dealing massive damage. They require extra energy to deploy as they are slightly older (but more experienced) than most troops.

hydra:member.name: clone_rifleman
hydra:member.description: 1... 2... wait what? These Riflemen multiply after being destroyed up to two times. Each clone is slightly weaker and deals less damage than the Rifleman before him.

hydra:member.name: critter_cannon
hydra:member.description: The critters' popularity and success in the battlefield inspired the creation of this prototype. Swamp enemies with these cute and deadly machines.

hydra:member.name: critter_engineer
hydra:member.description: This crafty Engineer has his own set of critters that he throws at enemy buildings.

hydra:member.name: cryobombardier
hydra:member.description: These Bombardiers throw ice bombs against enemy buildings, slowing them down and dealing moderate damage. They want everything to freeze, so they will always switch to unfrozen targets.

hydra:member.name: cryoneer
hydra:member.description: The Cryoneer freezes enemy buildings, slowing them down and dealing moderate damage. Your own troops are safe from the Freeze Beam.

hydra:member.name: cryotank
hydra:member.description: The CryoTank is a massive tank that freezes enemy buildings, slowing them down and dealing moderate damage. Each CyroTank requires extra Energy to land ashore.

hydra:member.name: dr_vitamin
hydra:member.description: Take your vitamins! Dr. Vitamin throws vitamins at other troops to boost one or many of their abilities for a short period of time.

hydra:member.name: grenadier
hydra:member.description: The Grenadier is a big and powerful ranged unit that deals area damage - rather inaccurately! Be careful about sending troops in front of him, as they might get caught in a grenade blast.

hydra:member.name: heavy
hydra:member.description: The Heavy can absorb a lot of damage and still keep on moving forward. He's happy to draw all the attention, and will take a punch to give a punch!

hydra:member.name: heavy_choppa
hydra:member.description: Like a buzzing wasp on a hot summer day, small and annoying and fires rockets at you!

hydra:member.name: hidden_warrior
hydra:member.description: This Tribal Warrior is hidden from enemy buildings and attacks, allowing him to sneak into enemy lines undetected. But once he starts attacking, the enemy will attack back!

hydra:member.name: incinerator
hydra:member.description: A more massive version of the scorcher, the MegaScorcher has more armor and causes bigger fires. It is also exceedingly large and takes a lot of energy to move.

hydra:member.name: laser_ranger
hydra:member.description: Laser Ranger uses her battery powered, handheld laser prototype to zap enemies in the line of sight.

hydra:member.name: lazortron
hydra:member.description: Breakthrough in the battery tech has allowed Blackguard to mount Lazor Beams on tanks. It will burn its way through enemy defenses with pinpoint precision.

hydra:member.name: mech
hydra:member.description: The Mech is a lean, mean fighting machine! He takes up a lot of space, but he can also take a lot of damage. His mighty autocannons stun their targets.

hydra:member.name: medic
hydra:member.description: Make love, not war! The Medic is opposed to all kinds of violence. Instead of grabbing a rifle, he heals other troops to help our cause.

hydra:member.name: melon_bombardier
hydra:member.description: The Bombardier is shooting... watermelons? Why not? Be careful though, these watermelons are exploding with flavor.

hydra:member.name: protector
hydra:member.description: This Native Islander is ready to help our cause against the Blackguard. She protects other troops with crystal shields for a short period of time.

hydra:member.name: rain_maker
hydra:member.description: This experimental long range artillery will outrange all but the most far-reaching defenses and rain down with its badaboom shells.

hydra:member.name: rifleman
hydra:member.description: Rifleman at the ready! Basic infantry units, the Riflemen are able to deal out and withstand moderate damage. In large enough numbers, they are almost unstoppable.

hydra:member.name: rocket_choppa
hydra:member.description: The flying clown car of the battlefield! Instead of laughs this unit delivers seemingly endless stream of bullets.

hydra:member.name: scorcher
hydra:member.description: The Scorcher is a massive, armored unit with a short range and attention span. It takes a boatload of Energy to deploy and leaves with a bang, harming everything nearby.

hydra:member.name: seeker
hydra:member.description: The Seeker is programmed to attack the nearest Engine Room, ignoring everything else. It can't be healed so make sure the path is clear!

hydra:member.name: shockaneer
hydra:member.description: The Shockaneer shocks enemy buildings, stunning them and dealing moderate damage. Enemies, beware of her Shock Beam!

hydra:member.name: stunner
hydra:member.description: The Stunner is one shockingly stunning troop that deals area damage - rather inaccurately! But his shock bomb grenades make up for his inaccuracy, stunning buildings and giving his teammates more time to attack.

hydra:member.name: tank
hydra:member.description: With its powerful gun and thick armor, the Tank is a real war machine! Due to its weight, each Tank needs extra Energy to land ashore.

hydra:member.name: turret_engineer
hydra:member.description: This crafty Engineer has designed compact turrets that expand upon hitting the ground and attack enemy buildings.

hydra:member.name: vampire_zooka
hydra:member.description: Vampire Zooka regains health as she shoots targets with her even longer range attack. She's moves quickly, so enemies should watch out!

hydra:member.name: warrior
hydra:member.description: The Tribal Warrior is an awesome sight in battle. He charges fearlessly, knowing that his Crystal Hammer will heal him with every blow.

hydra:member.name: zombie_rifleman
hydra:member.description: These Riflemen attack and respawn after being destroyed as slow, mindless zombies. Good luck trying to get these zombies to follow flares, Commander!

hydra:member.name: zooka
hydra:member.description: For long-range attacks, call in the Zooka. A few Zookas can completely devastate a whole enemy base, but don't let them come under fire from enemy turrets!

hydra:member.name: brick
hydra:member.description: After spending too long alone on the island, Sgt. Brick is ready to fight the Blackguard for real again.

hydra:member.name: bullit
hydra:member.description: It's not quite clear why Private Bullit has never been promoted, but it might have something to do with his attitude.

hydra:member.name: everspark
hydra:member.description: Some people just love gadgets. Cpt. Everspark takes after her mom, who has had a long career in weapons development.

hydra:member.name: kavan
hydra:member.description: Years in the jungle have had a pronounced effect on Dr. Kavan. He now uses natural oils to groom his moustache.

hydra:member.name: boom_mine
hydra:member.description: The Boom Mine stops the enemy in their tracks! Its high impact blast is focused in a small area.

hydra:member.name: mine
hydra:member.description: Mines trigger and explode when an enemy comes close. They deal area damage around them.

hydra:member.name: shock_mine
hydra:member.description: Shocking! Enemy troops caught in the area of effect are briefly stunned and unable to move or attack.

hydra:member.name: cluster_grenade
hydra:member.description: Throws a Cluster Grenade at the nearest building that not only explodes, but also peppers the area behind the target with explosive shrapnel.

hydra:member.name: iron_will
hydra:member.description: Mitigates damage taken by nearby troops for a duration.

hydra:member.name: battle_orders
hydra:member.description: Boosts damage and movement speed of nearby troops for a duration.

hydra:member.name: krystal_critters
hydra:member.description: Releases a cluster of crystal critters that heal wounded troops and disappear after a short duration.

hydra:member.name: ice_shields
hydra:member.description: Gives troops around the hero shields that absorb damage until destroyed. Excess damage from the hit that destroys the shield is negated.

hydra:member.name: second_wind
hydra:member.description: Temporarily revives fallen troops, except Seekers and Choppas. Latest casualties are revived first. If there is not enough capacity to revive a large troop, Riflemen appear instead.

hydra:member.name: critter_swarm
hydra:member.description: Releases a large swarm of critters.

hydra:member.name: explosive_charge
hydra:member.description: Throws a timed explosive that deals heavy damage at nearest defensive building.

hydra:member.name: universal_remote
hydra:member.description: Hacks the nearest defensive building and turns it against other defenses for a duration. Once the hacking effect expires, the building is stunned for a time. Cannot capture prototype weapons.

hydra:member.name: taunt
hydra:member.description: Limits maximum damage taken even more and taunts all defensive buildings within range, forcing them to shoot at the hero for a time.

hydra:member.name: energy_drink
hydra:member.description: Speeds up the hero's attack and movement while also granting him supernatural health regeneration.

hydra:member.name: shock_knuckles
hydra:member.description: Makes the hero attack the nearest defensive building with his fists, causing it and buildings behind it to be shocked.

hydra:member.name: ruddero
hydra:member.description: The Captain was rescued from a faraway island. Now he uses his experimental helipack to lead assaults from the air.

hydra:member.name: wingman_rush
hydra:member.description: Sends the wingmen forward to distract and shoot at enemies. Ruddero then rapidly deploys a new set of wingmen. Upgrading this ability also upgrades wingman stats.

hydra:member.name: bombing_run
hydra:member.description: Launches a bombing run in the direction Ruddero is facing. Flies in a line, then turns and comes back, dropping shrapnel bombs all the way.

hydra:member.name: mega_scorcher
hydra:member.description: The Scorcher is a massive, armored unit with a short range and attention span. It takes a boatload of Energy to deploy and leaves with a bang, harming everything nearby.

hydra:member.name: meatshield
hydra:member.description: Protects squad members by taking some of their damage on himself. Can redeploy troops freely anywhere on the battlefield.

hydra:member.name: zooka_fan
hydra:member.description: Aiming is overrated. You can shoot much farther if you fire upwards. Gives all squad members increased range but reduces accuracy.

hydra:member.name: minesweeper
hydra:member.description: All units in the squad clear Mines by walking into them when they are within range. Entire squad takes reduced damage from Mines.

hydra:member.name: clustardier
hydra:member.description: Uses a modified weapon that fires a barrage of bombs. They do less damage but destroy Mines.

hydra:member.name: bomb_and_shield
hydra:member.description: Each time a squad member is lost, remaining units in the squad gain a shield.

hydra:member.name: firebrand
hydra:member.description: Adds a burning effect to the squad's grenades. This causes continuous damage in a small area.

hydra:member.name: undercover_rifleman
hydra:member.description: These Riflemen are undercover, disguised as Blackguard troops. Enemy defenses will not attack them until the Riflemen start shooting.

hydra:member.name: heavy_fangirl
hydra:member.description: Julia is just a zooka girl. She has eaten with the heavies so she can take some additional hits and protect the others.

hydra:member.name: ninja_zooka
hydra:member.description: Squad members become stealthed if they have not attacked for a short while. Stealth is lost as soon as they attack.

hydra:member.name: mooka
hydra:member.description: Roberto has added a launcher to his zooka, so he can launch Flybots to demolish defenses He has also created Defenders to intercept incoming projectiles.

hydra:member.name: bunker
hydra:member.description: Bunkers allow you to garrison troops in your base. Troops can attack from inside the bunker. Some troops have extended range while in the bunker. The garrison cannot be stunned, taunted or frozen. When the bunker is destroyed, the garrison will leave the bunker and continue fighting.

hydra:member.name: adrenaline
hydra:member.description: Increases your units' movement and attack speed by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: support
hydra:member.description: Buildings transfer {effect} of damage taken to nearby buildings.

hydra:member.name: armor
hydra:member.description: Decreases the base damage per shot of enemy defenses by {secondaryEffect} but only up to {effect} reduction.

hydra:member.name: dampening
hydra:member.description: Decreases enemy defensive Statues' effectiveness by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: insulation
hydra:member.description: Reduces the duration of negative status effects on your troops by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: intel
hydra:member.description: Your troops gain {effect} of the opponent's offensive statue boosts.

hydra:member.name: leech
hydra:member.description: All units heal themselves {effect} of the damage they do.

hydra:member.name: motivation
hydra:member.description: Boosts your remaining units' speed by {effect} each time you lose a unit. Bigger units give more boost.

hydra:member.name: ordnance
hydra:member.description: Increases damage for Barrage and Artillery abilities by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: power_surge
hydra:member.description: Gives {effect} additional Gunboat energy for each destroyed building.

hydra:member.name: recycle
hydra:member.description: Increases loot gained by {effect} and converts looted construction resources to resource types you are missing.

hydra:member.name: sabotage
hydra:member.description: Decreases enemy defensive Statues' effectiveness by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: triage
hydra:member.description: Restores {effect} of lost units after a battle.

hydra:member.name: disruption
hydra:member.description: Reduces the effect of opponents' offensive statues by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: grounding
hydra:member.description: Reduces the amount of Gunboat energy opponents gain for each destroyed building by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: hardening
hydra:member.description: Reduces the damage of opponents' Gunboat abilities by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: insurance
hydra:member.description: Returns {effect} of the resources lost due to base being raided.

hydra:member.name: life_drain
hydra:member.description: Deals damage to attacker's units each second equal to {effect} of their base max health.

hydra:member.name: mind_control
hydra:member.description: You gain {effect} energy per second. At {secondaryEffect} energy resurrects fallen opponents to defend you.

hydra:member.name: mind_fog
hydra:member.description: Reduces the movement and attack speed of opponents' troops by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: overdrive
hydra:member.description: Increases the attack speed of your defenses by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: overheat
hydra:member.description: Gives opponent's Heroes and Leaders a {effect}s cooldown on their abilities.

hydra:member.name: shielding
hydra:member.description: Reduces the duration of negative status effects on your buildings by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: tinkering
hydra:member.description: You gain an additional prototype defense slot and Gunboat damage taken by prototypes is reduced by {effect}.

hydra:member.name: amani_kapata
hydra:member.description: Throws decoys towards enemy defenses instead of attacking. The decoys attract enemy fire like normal units.

hydra:member.name: antti_pylkas
hydra:member.description: Carries a drum-fed SMG with a lengthy burst attack and extended range, capable of quickly doing impressive damage.

hydra:member.name: freja_rygaard
hydra:member.description: Fires a laser beam in an arc in front of her.

hydra:member.name: honu
hydra:member.description: Uses his shield to take cover on the battlefield. He also carries self-made cherry bombs that he lobs in battle.

hydra:member.name: kai
hydra:member.description: Throws a projectile that bounces to multiple targets. Can throw a bomb that sets defenses on fire in an area.

hydra:member.name: linnea_friskdaul
hydra:member.description: Deals damage to defenses and can heal units on the battlefield based on damage dealt. Gives damage resistance to nearby units.

hydra:member.name: phasimov
hydra:member.description: Can fire a modified laser beam that temporarily phases targets. Phased targets can not shoot back, but any damage done is only applied when the target phases back.

hydra:member.name: firecrab
hydra:member.description: An ingenious flail device causes Mines to explode early, often damaging nearby buildings.

hydra:member.name: blobster
hydra:member.description: Transforms its turret based on incoming fire and shoots back using mimicked weaponry. Can also select which weapon to mimic.

hydra:member.name: doomfetti
hydra:member.description: Each squad member retreats once per battle after sufficiently damaged. Can deploy chaff to reduce defenses' range.

hydra:member.name: cr-cmd-010
hydra:member.description: Can be directed independently with a Squad Command. Gains a small speed boost for the command's duration.
